method: Wikipedia-first live browser-tool research; existing P10020 caches are identity hints. Exact Wikidata pages were separately opened and matched to APH MP IDs and English Wikipedia sitelinks where accessible. A single final broad pass used at most six queries per case, counting every query, including batched queries. No attendance decision has been applied.
time_precision: Access logs use observed UTC completion bounds from clock.curr_time, not fabricated per-request seconds. Each access occurred within the stated retrieval window; retrieved_at on proposals is the corresponding observed completion bound. web.run may return cached crawls; these timestamps describe tool retrieval, not publisher updates.

secondary_stage_audit_1151.note: Previously saved supporting URLs reopened and inspected before this observed completion bound; exact first-access time was not measured. No new queries in this inspection group.

secondary_stage_final_continuation.note: Four additional Peter Whish-Wilson queries finish his existing six-query final pass. Varun Ghosh's first genuine final pass stops at two queries after direct original-PDF retrieval and visual confirmation of explicit Year 11 attendance.
